_readme: A yard at 32px, for the world-scale gates and nothing else.
It is here rather than in data/maps because a shipped map is CONTENT: it would enter
the map validity gates, both editor round trips and map_io --verify, be exported to
Tiled and back, and be one more room nobody plays. MapData.root points here for the
suites that need a 32px world and is put back afterwards.
Walled all the way round, so a test that holds a direction stops rather than walking
out of the map, and one door-less room means no warp can fire mid-assertion.
